The '''Periphery''' was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that skirted [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was also bordered by the [[Ansuroer sector/Legends|Ansuroer sectors]] and the [[Karstaxon Regions]].

==Description==
A number of major hyperspace routes ran through the region, with the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] and the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] meeting at [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]], the region's capital. The [[Ac'fren Spur]] also ran from Sriluur out to the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] in nearby Hutt Space.<ref name="SSR" />

The Periphery was home to a number of sentient species, including the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]], the aquatic [[Sedrian]]s, the [[Ry'coz]], the [[Vaathkree (species)|Vaathkree]] and the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]]. Many other species immigrated to the region, including a number of long abandoned [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] colonies.

==History==
Located between [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] space and the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] at the time of the [[Xim Wars]], the Periphery was eventually absorbed in Hutt space after the victory of the [[Hutt Empire]].<ref name="TEA" /> The northern territories of Hutt space, which contained the Periphery, were known as the [[Kreetan Narrows]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

The Hutts lost control of the Periphery during the [[Hutt Cataclysms]] circa [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> but recovered it in the next millennia, as late as [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Cult of M'dweshuu]] was active in the region in the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].<ref name="hhn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|regional/13228_1.html|Nikto Cultists Plague Sisar Run}}</ref>

[[File:Sisar_Run.png|thumb|left|200px|The Periphery and the surrounding sectors.]]

At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Hutt Space was substantially reduced but the Kreetan Narrows remained under Hutt control. In the months following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the surrounding regions were the site of important [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist]] [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection|activity]]. After their defeat, the Separatists retreated to the Kreetan Narrows, leading to the [[Annexation of the northern Hutt territories|annexation of the region]], including the Periphery, by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> The Periphery became a subsector of the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

Given the region's proximity to Hutt Space, it was often thought that the Hutt criminal empires had significant influence in the region. In actuality, [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] controlled much of the region, through its [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Sprax]]. In addition to this activity, the region had been plagued for many years by the [[Disac pirates]] and well as the [[Ghilron pirates]]. The Disac pirates caused such significant interruption to Black Sun activities in the region that [[Ket Maliss]], personal assassin of Black Sun's head, was dispatched to eliminate the pirate group. The [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] was successful in this task, eliminating virtually the entire organization.<ref name="SSR" />

Around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] wrested control from the Hutts.<ref name="TEA" /> It was governed by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Newen Streeg]]. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] presence in the Periphery was spearheaded by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] the ''[[Ruthless]]'', while the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class cruiser]] ''[[Ion Storm]]'' patrolled the Sisar Run with a small patrol fleet. This fleet consisted of [[Interdictor-class cruiser|Interdictors]], [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|escort frigates]] and [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|carriers]] as well as smaller vessels like [[Patrol ship/Legends|System patrol craft]] and [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class light cruisers]].<ref name="SSR" /> While this presence had to deal with various criminal activities, it was also directed at activities of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] which was active in the region.<ref name="GOR" /> The Rebels even operated their own penal colony on [[Dles IV]] in the [[Dles system/Legends|Dles system]].<ref name="SSR" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a number of the regions' worlds such as Sriluur were overrun by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders.<ref name="GOR" />
